publicGates.command: node -e "const { total } = require('./cart'); const got = total([{ price: 10, qty: 2 }], 0.1); if (got !== 18) throw new Error('expected 18, got '+got);"

hiddenGates.command: node -e "const { total } = require('./cart'); const got = total([{ price: 1.255, qty: 2 }, { price: 3, qty: 1 }], 0.2); if (got !== 4.41) throw new Error('expected 4.41, got '+got);"
